concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-platforms-for-partners]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic partner-arrangement ecommerce guide for direct scheme-linked sub-merchants, SAQ A/KYC and Active-store gates, allowed origins and single-store routing.
warnings: This partner arrangement says the platform cannot process on behalf of sub-merchants. Ecommerce SAQ A is required before store creation; POS store users are exempt in this guide. The questionnaire response uses `redirectURL` in prose versus `redirectUrl` in JSON. Pending store or sample payment request is not activation or financial outcome.
